To strengthen the team, we are currently recruiting a  Manager Legal & Business Affairs strategic sparring partner to MD and Management As a trusted adviser, you are responsible for all legal aspects of the company's international commercial activities and play an active role in supporting its continued growth. You work closely with the sales team to draft, review and negotiate international commercial agreements. You also provide pragmatic legal advice on contractual matters and engage external counsel where specialist expertise is required. Furthermore, you professionalise contract management, maintain the contract database and oversee contract renewals.  Profile - a business partner and trusted advisor with a pragmatic approach - experience with drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts, such as licensing, distribution, supply, agency, service, development and collaboration agreements - combines legal expertise with commercial insight and clearly identifies risks and opportunities - fluent in English, conversational Dutch is preferred  Proposition - key role in a compact organisation where legal advice directly supports business growth - regulated, entrepreneurial setting, short lines and a high level of individual responsibility - opportunity to professionalise legal processes and contract management in a business that is scaling its pharmaceutical dossiers - flexibility to work from...
